capability.name: Multi-moneda y FX
intents: publicar o resolver una tasa de cambio
convertir una transacción a moneda funcional
traducir estados a moneda de grupo
explicar tasa fecha fuente y política aplicada
evaluar una operación cross-border o intercompany

dependencies: operation to rate-type and date policy
semantic gain loss adjustment and rounding account roles
restrictions: the browser and consuming domains never calculate or source authoritative rates
rates are append-only effective-dated and attributable
historical documents and postings retain their resolved rate snapshot
realized unrealized payment and rounding differences remain distinct
functional-currency balance is mandatory before Ledger posting
missing ambiguous stale or unauthorized rate fails closed
country and accounting-standard differences are governed policy rather than core branches

deterministic: inspect currency pair rate type validity source and snapshot
classify realized unrealized translation payment and rounding differences
identify the responsible ledger and semantic account roles
poDecision: accept FX ADR and commercial multicurrency scope
approve rate source fallback or override policy
approve functional currency activation or migration
prioritize cross-border intercompany or group translation coverage
architectHandoff: rate resolver inversion or triangulation semantics
reviewerGate: semantic AccountMap roles without country accounts in code
forbiddenWithoutApproval: publish or override an exchange rate

retrieval.provenance: FX capability derived from UBP ADR-0015 and extension anchors at pinned UBP revision ebf1c845bdf917d821f3182bff0cbe04c21d2c8e. The ADR is proposed and runtime completeness remains blocked.
